interpretation.plain_speak: For mixed histories, the exact sequence itself remains predictive across later phases even when our compressed encodings miss some of the signal. For observe-only histories, even exact sequence identity does not transfer, so that calibration relationship is changing with phase.
interpretation.next_stage: fit a frozen per-permutation linear training-phase trajectory and test extrapolation on untouched phases to determine whether observe4 is drifting systematically rather than randomly
